Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator instructed WebSurfer to research Palma, Indochine, Knickerbocker Bar & Grill, Babbo, and Lure Fishbar for vegan mains/prices without first verifying that these restaurants were within 1 block of Washington Square Park or met the dine-in criterion. This ignored the key geographic constraint and led the investigation down the wrong path (toward several far-away and upscale spots), preventing discovery of the correct answer (Shanghai Villa) and culminating in an incorrect final answer.
